status_note: r2 projection of the entry-granular ScopeLocal query layer (findOverlap/findAddr/findContainer/queryProperties over the oracle-proven rangemap). 27 records byte-identical on both sides. Overall UNTESTED: production funcdata consumers still use the second hand-rolled helper (r1 REJECT item 4, off-lease this round) and five residual domains stay UNTESTED below.

analysis_options.api: Direct ScopeLocal::findOverlap / findAddr / Scope::queryProperties and rudra::varmap::ScopeLocal::{find_overlap_entry, find_addr_entry, query_properties_ex} invocations with explicit (space, offset, size, usepoint) queries over hand-installed symbol/entry tables; no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.ghidra_funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned examples/curl input supplies the Ghidra Funcdata, address spaces, TypeFactory, Database flagbase and the persistent ScopeLocal (function GetStr at 0x36d0); symbols are installed through public production paths (Scope::addSymbol, Scope::addMapPoint, SymbolEntry::setUseLimit, Architecture::findAddJoin, Database::setPropertyRange, SymbolTable::addRange, ScopeLocal::markNotMapped, Scope::removeSymbol); every qp observable comes from the REAL Scope::queryProperties return (entry identity + flags), the answering scope is derived from that return (entry owner scope / persist bit / mapped|addrtied bits / property-only)
analysis_options.rugra_scope: Rugra builds an isolated ScopeLocal with an insertion-ordered LocalMapEntry log (maptable stand-in); per-entry uselimit range lists; parent global scope modeled as a second ScopeLocal with is_global_scope=true (space=ram); Database flagbase modeled as a closure over the readonly range; ghidra_space_index pins const=0 unique=2 ram=3 stack=8 as printed by the live oracle
analysis_options.ir: No P-code ops are constructed; the observable is exclusively per-query return identity (symbol name, entry first/last/offset/size, flags hex, answering scope)
analysis_options.normalization: No Ghidra/Rugra behavior difference is normalized or removed. The C++ dump keeps std::hex sticky across offset/size/flags; the Rust fixture formats all of them as hex explicitly. Ghidra-side BFD loader warnings stay on stderr (hash-pinned, byte-deterministic for the pinned binary); the Rust fixture emits none. Pointer/Arc addresses never appear in the records.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; all queries and construction are deterministic

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: queryProperties' uint4 &flags side-output is observed in all three branches (database.cc:1270 getAllFlags, 1273-1276 scope-derived mapped|addrtied(|persist)|property, 1279 property-only); findOverlap/findAddr return SymbolEntry identity (first/last/offset/size) not Symbol identity; the answering scope of the stackContainer walk (database.cc:951-961) is derived from the real queryProperties return.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: findOverlap walks the (last,subsort) multiset FORWARD from lower_bound(AddrRange(point)) (database.cc:2398, rangemap.hh:418); findAddr and findContainer walk the subsort-bounded window BACKWARD via --res.second (database.cc:2238-2245, 2267-2279); the equal-subsort bracketing quirk (second insert's hinted+tail double part, rangemap.hh:253-273 break-without-advancing-f) makes both walks answer the SECOND inserted; stackContainer walks this scope then parent (database.cc:951-961).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: findContainer's oldsize starts at the -1 sentinel, is updated ONLY after an in-use accept (database.cc:2271-2276), and the walk breaks on an exact-size hit (database.cc:2274); markNotMapped re-issues findOverlap after every removal (varmap.cc:528-544) and the parameter-offset window update happens before the removal loop (varmap.cc:520-524); wholeCount/multiEntrySet maintenance has no query observable and is not modeled.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: AddrRange::operator< orders the multiset by (last, subsort) (rangemap.hh:88-91); EntrySubsort::operator< orders by (useindex, useoffset) (database.hh:129-133) with addrtied symbols minimal (0,0) (database.cc:100-107); the findAddr/findContainer upper subsort bound is EntrySubsort(usepoint) built from the QUERY address (database.cc:2232-2237); inUse is uselimit RANGE containment in the usepoint's space (database.cc:114-120); removeRange splits bridging ownership ranges (address.cc:438-448).

functions: GetStr @ 0x36d0 (scope carrier only; identity asserted on the Ghidra side)
cases: setup: live space indices const=0 unique=2 ram=3 stack=8 — the EntrySubsort useindex dimension and the per-space maptable dimension both key on them
equal_subsort_overlap/findaddr: two entries with identical range AND subsort — both walks answer the SECOND inserted (hinted+tail bracketing)

wide_narrow_overlap(+_wide_cell): the EntrySubsort-minimum record (narrow, first use 0x1000) owns the shared cell [0x328,0x32b] although wide (first use 0x1100) was inserted first with the smaller start; the wide-only cell answers wide
wide_narrow_findaddr_midrange/wide_use/nouse: exact-start + RANGE-containment inUse — narrow admits 0x1050 mid-range, wide admits 0x1150, nothing admits 0x1050 at 0x320
multi_uselimit_second_range/gap: uselimit {[0x1000,0x100f],[0x2000,0x200f]} — usepoint 0x2005 answers (subsort from the first range), the 0x1500 gap does not
cross_space_stack_query/ram_query: a ram entry never answers a stack query and vice versa (maptable[space])
multi_mapping_first/second: ONE symbol with entries at [0x500,0x503] and [0x510,0x513] answers both queries with the respective entry extents
remove_requery_first/second/survivor: removeSymbol drops both mappings of the symbol and the survivor keeps answering (entry-log re-keying)
find_container_smallest: smallc [0x604,0x607] beats containing bigc [0x600,0x60f]; flags 0x208000 = mapped|addrtied
find_container_equal_tie: equal-size equal-subsort tie resolves to the LAST inserted (tieB) via the backward walk
partial_offset_piece_hi: the join symbol's [0x644,0x647] piece answers with getOffset()=4 and flags 0x4008000 = precishi|addrtied (mapped NOT set on pieces, database.cc:1172)
qp_scope_symbol_victim: victim symbol answers with 0x208000 (no readonly fold — installed before the property range)
marknotmapped_window: after markNotMapped(stack,0x900,4) the victim is gone and 0x902 answers property-only 0x2000 with scope=none (ownership window split)
qp_scope_only_property: 0x910 inside the owned window answers 0x20a000 = mapped|addrtied|readonly with scope=this
qp_parent_symbol: the global scope's gpar answers through the local query with 0x20c000 = mapped|addrtied|persist, scope=parent
qp_none: unique-space query with no symbol and no ownership answers flags=0 scope=none
qp_constant: constant-space address short-circuits to property-only flags=0 scope=none (database.cc:950)

setup_space_indices.covers: setup record: live oracle indices const=0 unique=2 ram=3 stack=8 equal Rugra's ghidra_space_index constants

equal_subsort_both_walks.covers: equal_subsort_overlap + equal_subsort_findaddr: the bracketing quirk — both the forward findOverlap walk and the backward findAddr walk answer the second inserted

wide_narrow_dual_order.covers: wide_narrow_overlap, wide_narrow_overlap_wide_cell, wide_narrow_findaddr_midrange, wide_narrow_findaddr_wide_use, wide_narrow_findaddr_nouse: cell ownership by EntrySubsort minimum vs exact-start backward walk with RANGE-containment inUse

multi_uselimit_containment.covers: multi_uselimit_second_range + multi_uselimit_gap: two disjoint uselimit ranges, subsort from the first, containment admission

multi_mapping_removal.covers: multi_mapping_first/second + remove_requery_first/second/survivor: multi-entry symbols, removeSymbol dropping every mapping, survivor re-keying

find_container_smallest_tie.covers: find_container_smallest + find_container_equal_tie: smallest-container selection, oldsize sentinel, exact-size break, equal-size equal-subsort tie to the last inserted

partial_offset_piece.covers: partial_offset_piece_hi: piece entries with getOffset()=4 and precishi extraflags (no mapped bit)

query_properties_local_branches.covers: qp_local_symbol + qp_scope_symbol_victim + qp_scope_only_property: getAllFlags branch, scope-owned mapped|addrtied|property branch, addMap property-fold avoidance

query_properties_parent_walk.covers: qp_parent_symbol + qp_none + qp_constant: parent (global scope) findContainer walk with persist, no-scope property-only, constant-space short-circuit

marknotmapped_window.covers: marknotmapped_window: markNotMapped removes overlapping symbols and splits the ownership window, flipping the scope-only branch to property-only

production_consumer_threading.covers: Funcdata::mapGlobals / linkSymbol / sync_varnodes_with_symbols still call the second hand-rolled funcdata.rs helper (scope_local_find_overlap, symbol-level, first-inserted tie — deviates from the bracketing quirk) and the spaceless has_overlap shim; production does not thread the parent scope or the query space

multientryset_wholecount.covers: wholeCount/multiEntrySet maintenance (database.cc:1866-1885, 2123) has no query observable in this domain and is not modeled; begin/endMultiEntry iteration consumers are untested

addmap_property_fold.covers: addMap folds Database property bits into address-tied symbol flags at construction time (database.cc:1153); Rugra's entry_all_flags has no fold (the fixture dodges it by construction ordering)

database_flagbase_partmap.covers: glb->symboltab->getProperty(addr) is a closure parameter in query_properties_ex; the Database flagbase partmap (database.hh:946, setPropertyRange state machine) is not ported

space_index_unverified_variants.covers: ghidra_space_index pins Register=4 Join=9 Iop=10 Overlay=11 Other=12 without oracle verification (inert for subsort comparisons — only uselimit spaces feed EntrySubsort); verified indices are const=0 unique=2 ram=3 stack=8
